reason: I already look at the group chat every night and I know my guys. If somebody sends the same receipt twice, I'll call him, I don't need a bot and a spreadsheet for that.
objection: A duplicate is a people problem, not a software problem. Another sheet in Google Drive is just one more thing nobody opens, me included.
would_change_my_mind: If I tried the free 40 on my old chat history and it found real money I missed, like double-paid invoices from a supplier, then I'd pay.
